follow-up time: Up to 10 years (from April 2012 to August 2022)
exposure: Resumption of blood flow in the scar
Resumption of blood flow (present vs absent)
cohort: Women who underwent TUFI for placenta previa-accreta and wished to conceive again
finding: MRI evaluation of TUFI scars at 12 months postoperatively, showing a scar thickness ≥ 70% of the surrounding area and at least partial resumption of blood flow, may be a reasonable criterion for permitting a subsequent pregnancy.
